content: New type system: Fraunces (variable display) + DM Sans (body) + JetBrains Mono (labels)
New color system: deeper midnight + electric cobalt + ultraviolet + cold luminous white glow + rare burnt amber
New motion system: kinetic word cycling, masked reveals, mouse parallax, scene transitions
Redesign Home: asymmetric cinematic hero + thesis + narrative value scenes + reinvented offer + immersive work chapters + new process + emotional closing
Redesign Work list: immersive alternating chapter spreads (no card grid)
Redesign Services/Process/About/Contact with new visual system
Refresh Nav + Footer + Admin with new tokens
Update copy to v2 voice (bolder, confrontational, emotional)
Regression test: backend APIs + admin still work after redesign (100% backend / 98% frontend)
